dcterms:description: The dataset consists of 111 controls and 29 cases, with each subject having a PIB measure (that corresponds to the Aβ deposition), age, and gender. The input tensor covariates are of dimension 80 × 80 for each subject, which is the connectivity matrix for the 80 regions of interest (ROI) computed from different measures.
dcterms:title: Berkeley Aging Cohort Study (BACS)
